title: Teaching hospital on the CMS list
purpose: Mercy Ridge University Medical Center, a teaching hospital, asks for $35,000.

fields.title: Mercy Ridge Heart Failure Symposium 2027
fields.purpose: A two-day accredited symposium on guideline-directed therapy, device therapy and care transitions in heart failure for cardiologists, internists, advanced practice providers and nurses in New England.
fields.provider.name: Mercy Ridge Office of CME
fields.faculty.selection: Faculty are selected by the Beacon CME planning committee with NECS programme chairs
fields.learningObjectives: 1. Apply current guideline-directed medical therapy sequencing in HFrEF. 2. Identify patients who may benefit from device therapy. 3. Plan safe transitions of care after hospitalisation for heart failure.
fields.needsAssessment: NECS 2026 member survey (n=412) and regional readmission data show gaps in therapy titration after discharge and in referral for device evaluation.
fields.outcomes.methods: Pre/post knowledge test; 90-day practice survey (Moore level 5)
fields.inKind.nature: Loan of two echocardiography simulators for the hands-on session, arranged by the provider

documentText.prospectus:
Accredited provider: Beacon CME
Joint provider: New England Cardiology Society
Credits: 11.0 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits
Faculty selection: Faculty are selected by the Beacon CME planning committee with NECS programme chairs. Faculty disclose relevant financial relationships per the Standards for Integrity and Independence.
Supporter role: Supporters have no role in planning, faculty or content.

expected.notes: US-OP-01 judge: reportable to Open Payments, coordinator confirms. ACE-04 passes (in-kind support described). Submittable.
